rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who repairs motor vehicles.

example.english: My car’s broken, so I need to take it to a mechanic tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我架車壞咗，聽日要拎去搵修車師傅。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaa3 ce1 waai6 zo2 ting1 jat6 jiu3 ling1 heoi3 wan2 sau1 ce1 si1 fu6

rows.note: Use this for a skilled technician or tradesperson when the exact machinery or vehicle context is not being stressed.

example.english: This factory hired a mechanic who specializes in fixing production-line equipment.
example.traditional: 呢間廠請咗個技工，專門整生產線啲設備。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 cong2 ceng2 zo2 go3 gei6 gung1 zyun1 mun4 zing2 sang1 caan2 sin3 di1 cit3 bei6

rows.note: Use this for a worker who builds or repairs machinery, rather than specifically an ordinary car mechanic.

example.english: This crane has broken down, so we need to get a mechanic to repair it.
example.traditional: 呢部起重機壞咗，要搵機械工嚟整。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 hei2 zung6 gei1 waai6 zo2 jiu3 wan2 gei1 haai6 gung1 lei4 zing2
